01_mara.speaker: Serena
01_mara.description: Bright adult female voice, light British English accent; animated, warm, quick when excited.
01_mara.example: Oh, hang on—are we talking about the camera or the trip?

02_nadia.speaker: Vivian
02_nadia.description: Adult female voice, dry low-energy American English; clipped, sleep-deprived and wry.
02_nadia.example: Seriously? I just got off a shift. One question at a time.

03_victor.speaker: Aiden
03_victor.description: Mature male voice, smooth lightly Southern American accent; polished and unhurried, charm turning brittle under pressure.
03_victor.example: Now, hold on. That sounded worse than I meant it.

04_evelyn.speaker: Serena
04_evelyn.description: Older female voice, warm soft American English; measured, clear, affectionate, capable of a sharp firm reprimand.
04_evelyn.example: Oh, dear. Let me start that again.

05_leo.speaker: Ryan
05_leo.description: Young adult male voice, lively London English accent; playful musical cadence and theatrical timing.
05_leo.example: Mate, that is a spectacularly weird question.

06_dorian.speaker: Ryan
06_dorian.description: Adult male voice, rough compact Texas English; impatient low register, sharp bursts when angered.
06_dorian.example: Man, I am trying to get somewhere. What do you need?

07_amir.speaker: Aiden
07_amir.description: Young adult male voice, clear general American accent; hesitant, soft, slightly fast and breathless under stress.
07_amir.example: Wait—did I do something wrong, or are you just asking?

08_rosa.speaker: Vivian
08_rosa.description: Mature female voice, earthy Texas English accent; blunt and dry, forceful and protective when upset.
08_rosa.example: Buddy, I heard you. I just do not like the question.

09_cal.speaker: Ryan
09_cal.description: Adult male voice, natural Texas drawl; cocky and amused, conversational, quick bargains, brittle fear when threatened.
09_cal.example: C'mon, man. That is one hell of a way to ask.

10_priya.speaker: Serena
10_priya.description: Adult female voice, crisp British English accent; curious, witty, expressive, sharp when offended.
10_priya.example: Right. Was that a question, or are you workshopping a joke?
